title: Validate finite values in SelectorMixin transform for pandas output
answers: Why does SelectKBest.transform allow inf values when using set_output(transform='pandas')?
How does SelectorMixin validate non-finite values when preserving pandas DataFrame input?
Feature selector transform fails to reject infinite values with pandas output
body:
Symptom: Feature selector transform allows infinite values or unexpected NaNs when set_output(transform="pandas") is enabled.
Root cause: sklearn/feature_selection/_base.py:SelectorMixin.transform skips array checking via validate_data(skip_check_array=preserve_X), bypassing ensure_all_finite validation.
Fix pattern: Explicitly call assert_all_finite(X) when preserve_X is True and NaN values are not allowed.
Constraints: Applies only when preserve_X is True and get_tags(self).input_tags.allow_nan is False; estimators with allow_nan=True (e.g., VarianceThreshold) remain exempt.
applies: Feature selectors inheriting from SelectorMixin when transforming pandas DataFrames with set_output(transform='pandas')
